dct_description_sm:
Continues tables in CANSIM cross-classified database "https://mdl.library.utoronto.ca/collections/numeric-data/cansim-cross-classified-database-education-may-1998-ed" which covers the years 1960-61 to 1994-95.

6 data files (MS Excel format) & accompanying documentation (2 MS Word files)

The Elementary-Secondary Education Statistics Project (ESESP) is a national survey that enables Statistics Canada to provide information on enrolments (including minority and second language programs), graduates, educators and finance of Canadian elementary-secondary public educational institutions.
dct_rights_sm: Openly available under the Statistics Canada open license agreement
